title: Fermented Asparagus Wrap Keto Snack
description: A simple keto snack that combines fermented vegetables with fresh asparagus and a crunchy wrap. Perfect for a quick pick-me-up.
instructions: 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
3. Arrange the fresh asparagus spears on the baking sheet.
4. Roast the asparagus in the oven for 12-15 minutes, or until tender.
5. Meanwhile, warm the low-carb tortilla wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
6. Spread the fermented asparagus on the tortilla wrap.
7. Top with roasted asparagus, mozzarella cheese, and chopped cilantro.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
9. Roll up the wrap tightly and slice in half.
